signatures.name: toolfailure: command failed with exit code <num>
at most <num> executions may run per session, and <num> are running: <id>.
regular expressions are not available; use string methods.

definitions.admission: An execute tool record with status completed. On asynchronous versions this proves only that the program was admitted.
definitions.completion: Decided by the first available source in order: codemode_execution row, completion notification (current failed or legacy error both mean failed), lifecycle metadata on the tool record, the tool record itself for synchronous versions; otherwise unknown.
definitions.episode: Starts at a refused execute call or an admitted execution that did not save, includes every following execute call in the session, and closes at the first call whose execution saved (recovered), after followupCalls further calls without a save (unrecovered, or unknown when a completion was unknown), or at session end.
definitions.holdout: The newest terminal sessions by time_created (ties by id descending), up to options.holdout.
definitions.ranking: Orders review candidates by the published weighted components; it does not produce guidance.
definitions.retryRelation: Each call in an episode is compared with the call before it: exact (identical source), normalized (identical after whitespace collapse), fingerprint (identical sorted static tool paths and top-level declared names), otherwise different.

failureRules.name: tool-input
failureRules.pattern: ^(?:invalid arguments for tool|invalid input for tool|expected number)

failureRules.name: commit-conflict
failureRules.pattern: (?:are no longer reserved by this execution|was reverted; nothing was saved|nothing was saved\.$)

journalRules.name: file-not-found
journalRules.pattern: ^(?:file not found|search path does not exist)

journalRules.name: patch
journalRules.pattern: ^(?:patch verification failed|could not find oldstring in)

refusalRules.name: concurrency-limit
refusalRules.pattern: ^(?:at most <num> executions may run|code mode allows at most <num> concurrent executions)

refusalRules.name: tool-path
refusalRules.pattern: ^(?:tools must be called through|the tool namespace only)

refusalRules.name: notebook-limit
refusalRules.pattern: ^(?:this session's notebook would hold|one execution may declare at most)
